import unittest
from conftest import trace


class AsyncCase(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        trace("async-sync-setUp")
        self.addCleanup(trace, "async-sync-cleanup")

    async def asyncSetUp(self):
        trace("asyncSetUp")
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.clean_async)

    async def clean_async(self):
        trace("async-cleanup")

    async def test_async(self):
        trace("async-body")

    async def asyncTearDown(self):
        trace("asyncTearDown")

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("async-sync-tearDown")
